question: Which physically different anonymous observations repeatedly occupy the same surrounding structural slots without using inherited state labels, cultural metadata, language labels, chronology, or semantic interpretation?

allowedSlotEvidence: target region geometry relative to its minimal strict containing observation
parent region geometry relative to its own parent when present
count and region geometry of non-overlapping siblings
topology summaries of non-overlapping siblings only
maskBoundary.reason: The empty slot must be discoverable without smuggling the occupant's pixels back into its context through the target, an ancestor, or an overlapping proposal.

occupantDiscovery.input: target observation raw normalized topology only; no state labels or slot-family labels

clustering.selection: highest deterministic sampled silhouette; lower k breaks ties
clustering.transfer: holdout and control assigned to frozen train centroids without refit

substitutionTest.physicalDifferenceGate: occupant centroid distance at or above the median pair distance in frozen train topology space
substitutionTest.functionalSimilarity: cosine similarity of each occupant family's distribution across frozen slot families
secondaryEvidence: sources containing both occupants in the same slot family
holdout/control pair similarity percentile among all frozen occupant-family pairs

nullModel.evaluation: for each frozen train-selected pair, compare holdout/control slot-distribution similarity to deterministic random pairs of frozen physical occupant families in that lane
nullModel.purpose: test whether the same physical family correspondence transfers better than an arbitrary physical-family pairing; do not destroy slot structure or refit vocabularies

falsifiers.noStableSlotVocabulary: If masked contexts do not form supported train-discovered slot families, the corpus does not support this level of structural-slot abstraction.
falsifiers.noInterchangeablePhysicalFamilies: If physically separated occupant families do not share slot distributions beyond isolated examples or fail to transfer, functional substitution is not supported at this representation.
falsifiers.transferFailure: If train-selected substitutable pairs lose their slot-distribution similarity in both independent lanes, the apparent interchangeability is institution-local or overfit.
